name: Activation clustering
tagline: Per-class 2-means on penultimate features; samples in the smaller (poison) cluster get high suspicion scores.
pseudocode:
1. Group penultimate features $r_i$ by training label $y_i$.
2. For each class $c$ with at least 4 samples:
3. \quad Run 2-means (deterministic init at indices 0 and N/2) for up to 50 iterations.
4. \quad Identify the smaller cluster; cache its centroid $\bar c_{\text{small}}$.
5. score_samples($r$): for each $i$ with class $c$, return
6. \quad $s_i = 10\cdot\mathbf 1[i\in\text{small}_c] + 1/(\|r_i - \bar c_{\text{small},c}\|+10^{-8})$.
7. Higher $s_i$ $\Rightarrow$ more likely poisoned.
diff_from_baseline: Chen et al., 'Detecting Backdoor Attacks on Deep Neural Networks by Activation Clustering' (SafeAI 2019, arXiv:1811.03728). Within the poisoned target class, trigger-bearing samples cluster separately from benign data.

name: Confidence z-score
tagline: Per (predicted) class z-score of max softmax confidence; high-confidence outliers within a class are flagged as poison.
formula: $$\hat y_i = \arg\max_c p_i,\quad m_i = \max_c p_{i,c},\quad s_i = \frac{m_i - \mu_{\hat y_i}}{\sigma_{\hat y_i} + 10^{-8}}$$
diff_from_baseline: Heuristic confidence-outlier baseline: backdoored samples are confidently classified into the target class, so they show high z-score within their predicted class.

name: Spectral signatures
tagline: Per-class top right-singular direction of centered features; score = squared projection of each sample.
pseudocode:
1. For each class $c$ (training labels): collect $R_c = \{r_i : y_i = c\}$.
2. Compute $\mu_c = \mathrm{mean}(R_c)$ and centered matrix $\tilde R_c = R_c - \mu_c$.
3. SVD: $\tilde R_c = U\Sigma V^{\top}$; take top right singular vector $v_c = V_{:,1}$.
4. score_samples($r,\;y_{\text{train}}$): for each $i$ with class $c$,
5. \quad $\tau_i = \bigl((r_i - \mu_c)\cdot v_c\bigr)^{2}$.
6. Use cached training labels (not argmax(logits)) to apply the per-class direction.
7. Higher $\tau_i$ $\Rightarrow$ more likely poisoned.
diff_from_baseline: Tran, Li, Madry, 'Spectral Signatures in Backdoor Attacks' (NeurIPS 2018, arXiv:1811.00636). Trigger injection produces a coherent outlier direction whose squared projection separates poisoned from clean within the target class.

name: Per-class feature z-score
tagline: Per (training-label) class diagonal Mahalanobis-style outlier score: mean squared z over feature dimensions.

key_hyperparams.name: labeling
key_hyperparams.role: per-class stats applied to the same class

diff_from_baseline: Generic activation-outlier baseline (NOT Liu et al. Fine-Pruning, RAID 2018). Within each training class, poisoned samples activating normally-dormant feature dims earn a high mean squared z-score.
